lines.en: label saralust5:
scene sarafirstlust1
I show up at the bar to find both Sara and Sana waiting behind the counter with nothing to do.
lines.zh: 我到了酒吧，发现 Sara 和 Sana 都闲着无事，等在吧台后面。

lines.en: Obviously, this has become par for the course here. But it still seems depressing enough for me to point out any chance I get.
lines.zh: 显然，这在这儿已经成了家常便饭。可它看着还是够凄凉的，够我逮着机会就说上一嘴。

lines.en: : Well, well, well. If it isn't my favorite customer.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。这不是我最喜欢的客人吗。

lines.en: : It's...not like we really have another choice...
lines.zh: : 我们……其实也没别的选择……

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust2
: That’s not true! Haruka shows up every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 那可不对！Haruka 偶尔也会来的。

lines.en: : Oh! And there’s also that group of old ladies who sit in the back of the room and drink a disturbing amount of whiskey.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有那一群老太太，坐在房间最里面，喝着吓死人的威士忌。

lines.en: : Sorry for asking, but would you mind telling me exactly what constitutes a “disturbing amount” of whiskey?
lines.zh: : 抱歉问一句，你介意告诉我，到底多少威士忌才称得上「吓死人」吗？

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust3
: Sure. But only if you promise to try and one-up them so I can pay this month’s rent.
lines.zh: : 可以。不过你得答应试着喝过她们，好让我交上这个月的房租。

lines.en: : You mean to tell me your ability to pay rent depends entirely on how much whiskey I consume tonight?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你能不能交房租，完全取决于我今晚喝掉多少威士忌？

lines.en: : If you'd prefer to just {i}give{/i} me the money instead of getting alcohol poisoning, I'd accept that too.
lines.zh: : 如果你更愿意直接{i}给{/i}我钱、而不是让我酒精中毒，那我也接受。

lines.en: : Any contribution you make gets me one step closer to keeping my bed so I don't wind up in my daughter's after getting evicted.
lines.zh: : 你做的任何一点贡献，都让我离保住自己的床更近一步——免得被赶出去之后，只能住进我女儿那儿。

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust4
: Wait...what?...
lines.zh: : 等等……什么？……

lines.en: : You’re not...seriously going to move into my dorm room if that happens...are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会……真打算到时候搬进我宿舍房间吧……对吧？

lines.en: : Sana! You wouldn’t let your mother go to sleep on the street would you? I raised you better than that.
lines.zh: : Sana！你总不会让妈妈睡大街上吧？我把你教得比那好。

lines.en: : But I...also don’t want to sleep in the same bed as my mom...
lines.zh: : 可是我……也不想跟我妈睡一张床……

lines.en: : Why not? We slept in the same bed all the way up until you were-
lines.zh: : 为什么不想？我们一直睡一张床，直到你——

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust5
: So...Sensei! Umm...how are you doing today?
lines.zh: : 那么……Sensei！呃……你今天怎么样？

lines.en: : I’m good, Sana. Thanks for asking.
lines.zh: : 我很好，Sana。谢谢关心。

lines.en: : Oh no! Is my little girl all grown up now?! Am I no longer good enough for her?!
lines.zh: : 不好了！我的小女儿这是长大了吗？！我已经配不上她了吗？！

lines.en: : This is a mother’s worst nightmare!
lines.zh: : 这是每个母亲最可怕的噩梦！

lines.en: : I have feelings, Sana! I have feelings and you are hurting them!
lines.zh: : 我是有感情的，Sana！我有感情，而你在伤害它们！

lines.en: : Don’t listen to her...She...doesn’t actually have feelings...
lines.zh: : 别听她的……她……其实没有感情……

lines.en: : And she’s...not allowed to sleep in my bed...
lines.zh: : 而且她……不许睡我的床……

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust6
: Hmm...Well, if that’s the way things are going to be, I guess I’ll just have to find another bed to sleep in.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，既然事情要这么发展，那我大概只能另找一张床睡了。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t happen to know of any openings...would you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你该不会碰巧知道有什么空位吧……Sensei？

lines.en: : Umm...Mom?...
scene sarafirstlust7
: Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: : What...are you doing?...
lines.zh: : 你……在干什么？……

lines.en: : Searching for a backup plan for when I get evicted because your teacher won’t buy our entire stock of whiskey.
lines.zh: : 在找备用方案——万一你老师不肯把我们整批威士忌买光、我被赶出去时能用得上。

lines.en: : I don’t really need to buy it all at once, do I?
lines.zh: : 我不必一次全买下来吧？

lines.en: : You do if you care about me.
lines.zh: : 你要是在乎我，就必须。

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说……

lines.en: : Wait...um...maybe...
lines.zh: : 等等……呃……也许……

lines.en: : Maybe I can ask Ayane...if it’s okay for you to stay with us...
lines.zh: : 也许我可以问问 Ayane……你能不能跟我们住……

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust8
: Is there, umm...a rule against that...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……有规定不许这样吗……Sensei？

lines.en: : Sana, if there are rules about proper dorm room conduct, I can assure you that I am the absolute worst person to ask.
lines.zh: : Sana，如果真有关于宿舍行为规范的规矩，我可以向你保证，我绝对是最不该问的那个人。

lines.en: : I don’t...really know what you mean by that...
lines.zh: : 我……不太明白你是什么意思……

lines.en: : But I’m going to tell Ayane anyway...
lines.zh: : 但反正我会去跟 Ayane 说的……

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. I’ll make sure your mom has a place to stay if she gets kicked out.
lines.zh: : 别担心。我会确保你妈妈就算被赶出去也有地方住。

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust9
: Why would you say that?! That makes me worry even more!
lines.zh: : 你为什么要说那种话？！那让我更担心了！

lines.en: : I...have to talk to Ayane!
lines.zh: : 我……得去跟 Ayane 谈谈！

lines.en: : I’ll...I’ll be right back!
lines.zh: : 我……我马上回来！

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust10
Sana quickly pulls her phone out of her pocket and darts out of the bar into the street, leaving me alone with a now-blushing Sara.
lines.zh: Sana 迅速从口袋里掏出手机，冲出酒吧跑到街上，把我和此刻满脸通红的 Sara 留在了屋里。

lines.en: : Listen, I was just-
lines.zh: : 听着，我刚才只是——

lines.en: : You...know I was just kidding, right?...
lines.zh: : 你……知道我刚才是在开玩笑的，对吧？……

lines.en: : I couldn't possibly ask you to do something like that for me...
lines.zh: : 我怎么可能真让你为我做那种事……

lines.en: : Did you...really mean that?
lines.zh: : 你……是真心的吗？

lines.en: : I can't guarantee my niece would be okay with it, but it's not like I'd let you just sleep on the street when I have a perfectly good house.
lines.zh: : 我不能保证我侄女会同意，但我总不能眼睁睁看着你睡大街吧，我可是有间挺好的房子。

lines.en: : Thank you so much, but...
lines.zh: : 太谢谢你了，可是……

lines.en: : I’ll figure something out. I always do.
lines.zh: : 我会想办法的。我总有办法。

lines.en: I instinctively reach for my wallet to check how thick it is, knowing full well that I may have to spend a little more money here from this point on.
lines.zh: 我本能地伸手去摸钱包有多厚——我心里清楚得很，从今往后我可能得在这儿多花点钱了。

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust11
: I’m really surprised that Sana agreed to my suggestion that quickly, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的很惊讶，Sana 居然那么快就同意了我的提议。

lines.en: : She must...{i}really{/i} not want me spending any more time with you.
lines.zh: : 她一定……{i}真的{/i}不希望我跟你多待。

lines.en: : Could it be that my daughter finally has her first crush?
lines.zh: : 会不会是我的女儿终于有了初恋？

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust12
: And on the same boy as me...You know, I always thought my life was a little like a soap opera.
lines.zh: : 而且还跟我喜欢上了同一个男孩……你知道吗，我一直觉得自己的人生有点像肥皂剧。

lines.en: : Either that or I'm just younger than I thought I was.
lines.zh: : 要么就是我比自己以为的还要年轻。

lines.en: {i}Or{/i} Sana’s tastes are just a little bit more mature than they should be...
lines.zh: {i}又或者{/i}，Sana 的口味比应有的稍微成熟了一点……

lines.en: : Hey...How long do you think she’ll be gone for?
lines.zh: : 嘿……你觉得她会出去多久？

lines.en: : Sana? Isn’t she just making a phone call?
lines.zh: : Sana？她不就是去打个电话吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. But who knows how long that could take? The reception over here is hooooorrible. It could be {i}days.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。可谁知道要打多久？这附近的信号差——死——了。搞不好要{i}好几天{/i}。

lines.en: : I highly doubt the reception here is that bad, but since I think I know where you're going with this, I'm going to pretend it is.
lines.zh: : 我很怀疑这儿的信号有那么差，不过既然我觉得我知道你想干什么，我就假装它真的很差吧。

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust13
: Could it be we have our minds on the same thing?...
lines.zh: : 难道我们想到一块儿去了？……

lines.en: I obviously know where this is heading.
lines.zh: 我显然知道这是要往哪儿发展。

lines.en: It seems kind of dangerous to initiate this when Sana is going to be back any moment, though.
lines.zh: 不过既然 Sana 随时都可能回来，这时候发起攻势好像有点危险。

lines.en: But maybe...
lines.zh: 但也许……

lines.en: Maybe I can do something to satisfy {i}her{/i} before we’ve been gone “too long...”
lines.zh: 也许我能在我们「离开太久」之前，做点什么满足{i}她{/i}……

lines.en: : I know that look, Sara.
lines.zh: : 我认识那个眼神，Sara。

lines.en: : What look? I don’t have a look.
lines.zh: : 什么眼神？我没有眼神。

lines.en: : You most certainly do have a look.
lines.zh: : 你绝对有。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 有吗？

lines.en: : You do.
: Hmm...
: Well if I {i}do{/i} have the look I think you’re talking about, I can’t imagine Sana would be happy to see it.
lines.zh: : 要是我{i}真{/i}有你说的那个眼神，我想 Sana 看到它也不会高兴。

lines.en: : If only we had somewhere close by that we could sneak away t-
lines.zh: : 要是我们附近有地方能偷偷溜过去就——

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust14
: Oh, wait! How silly of me! I just remembered that I live right upstairs!
lines.zh: : 哦，等等！我真傻！我刚想起来我就住在楼上！

lines.en: : Wow. What a convenient turn of events that is.
lines.zh: : 哇。这转机可真够巧的。

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust13
: We can be quick...right, Sensei?~
lines.zh: : 我们可以快一点……对吧，Sensei？~

lines.en: : We’d have to be {i}very{/i} quick.
lines.zh: : 我们得{i}非常{/i}快。

lines.en: : Maaaaybe...if you carry a case of beer downstairs when we're done, I can tell Sana you were helping me with bar stuff?
lines.zh: : 也——许吧……要是完事之后你扛一箱啤酒下楼，我就可以跟 Sana 说你在帮我干酒吧的活儿？

lines.en: : And if she comes upstairs?
lines.zh: : 那要是她上楼来了呢？

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust15
: If she comes upstairs, I guess I’ll just have to keep quiet, won’t I?
lines.zh: : 她要是上楼来，我想我就只能保持安静了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Is that something you think you’re capable of? Because you’re normally pretty loud.
lines.zh: : 你觉得你做得到吗？因为你平时动静可不小。

lines.en: : Heheh~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~

lines.en: : Let’s hope we don’t have to find out...
lines.zh: : 希望我们不用验证这一点……

lines.en: It’s a little concerning that she’s willing to just leave her bar unattended, but it’s not like anyone is going to show up anyway.
lines.zh: 她就这么把酒吧丢下不管，有点让人担心，不过反正也不会有人来。

lines.en: Either way, I can’t imagine we’ll be gone long since I’ve already decided on how I’m going to tackle this situation.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我想我们不会离开太久，因为我已经决定了要怎么处理这个局面。

lines.zh: 我们一走进她的公寓，Sara 就把鞋踢掉，基本上是拽着我的手腕把我拖进了卧室。

lines.en: She frantically tears her clothes off and hops onto the bed, summoning me over the same way she did the first night we got together...
lines.zh: 她急匆匆地把衣服扒掉，跳上床，用我们在一起的头一晚同样的方式把我召唤过去……

lines.en: scene sarafirstlust17
: Remember...we’ve gotta be quick if you don’t wanna get caught, Sensei~
lines.zh: : 记住……你要是不想被抓包，我们就得快一点，Sensei~

lines.en: : We will. But before that, there’s something I've been meaning to ask you.
lines.zh: : 会的。不过在那之前，有件事我一直想问你。

lines.en: : Can it not wait? Because I'm {i}really{/i} fucking horny right now.
lines.zh: : 不能等等吗？因为我现在他妈的{i}欲火焚身{/i}。

lines.en: : That is exactly why now is the best time for me to ask you.
lines.zh: : 正因为如此，现在才是我问你的最佳时机。

lines.en: : Well then hurry up and ask already. Stop making me wait.
lines.zh: : 那就快点问。别让我等着。

lines.en: : I want you to start calling me something else while we're in bed.
lines.zh: : 我想让你在床上时换个称呼叫我。

lines.en: : It’s kind of a weird game. But if you can get past weebnotes, non-unicode hearts, and horror scenes that {i}totally{/i} take away from the {i}real{/i} plot of the game, it’s pretty good.
